records.thinker_text: The sky is blue because of the way Earth's atmosphere scatters sunlight. Sunlight is made up of three types of gases, with the atmosphere being mostly made up of red, orange, and pink hues. These gases can be obscured by the sun and are scattered across the sky. Blue light is scattered more than other colors because it travels in shorter wavelengths, making the scattered clouds appear blue.
